description.value: Sing Sing is a lively, late-night pub on Main Street serving craft beer and Asian comfort food in a modern, open space. The venue features both indoor and outdoor seating with a no-smoking policy and diverse cuisine (American, Italian pizza, Vietnamese). A welcoming stop for touring cyclists seeking an evening meal or social atmosphere.
